children: KKR & Co Inc (NYSE:KKR) is reshaping its portfolio: it arranged a $2.1B leveraged loan to fund the Integer takeover, is investing €528M for 49% of a European net-lease JV with Realty Income, sold its 19.9% First Gen stake for ~₱25.77B, and named Marco Nespolo to lead FiberCop.
: KKR arranged a $2.1B leveraged loan to fund its acquisition of Integer, finalizing the financing package to support the deal.
: KKR invests about €528M to buy 49% of a euro-denominated joint venture with Realty Income, backing a 54-property, 140-unit European net-lease portfolio (5.9% initial cap rate); close Sept 30, 2026.
: KKR sold its entire 19.9% stake in First Gen — 715.9M shares — to Angsana Finance for ~25.77 billion PHP (~$410.5M), ending its six-year investment after a rejected expansion proposal.
: KKR, 37.5% owner of FiberCop, nominated Marco Nespolo as FiberCop CEO to replace Massimo Sarmi; appointment expected this autumn. Italian Treasury holds 16% stake.
